name: Judge Run Health: Decisions Graded
extraData: {"description":"Judge-run health saved view (#53), turning docs/judge-run.md's troubleshooting table into a live query. Graphs gradebook.decisions.graded (increase/sum, no filter) grouped by augmentloop.grade.source and gen_ai.evaluation.score.label over the currently-selected time range. Empty chart => the same root cause as the doc's 'Dashboard panels empty' row: either the replay hasn't been run yet, the time range doesn't cover when it ran, or OTLP wasn't ready when it was run (see docs/judge-run.md Troubleshooting). Non-empty bars/lines broken down by source+label => the pipeline is alive and grading. Recommended range when checking right after a replay: Last 30 minutes (matches docs/judge-run.md step 4-5 guidance). NOTE (verified 2026-07-25 against this deployment): increase()/rate() on this metric returns real data for windows up to ~3h and silently returns null for 6h+ windows - keep the Explorer time range short (well under a day) or the view will look falsely empty."}
